summary: Map AAP UI and API accounts to an external authentication source where possible, including service accounts, and keep local accounts such as `admin` for break-glass access. Supported sources: LDAP, SAML, TACACS+, RADIUS, Azure AD, Google OAuth, generic OIDC, Keycloak and GitHub (org, team, enterprise variants); auth traffic must be encrypted (LDAPS, HTTPS).
